edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: The underlying diseases were: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL; 30), Gaucher (5), Niemann-Pick (4), mitochondrial (4), Lafora (3), Krabbe (2), and KCNC1 gene mutation (2).
